chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) regarding the obligation of following the truth when the Proof (Imam) rises.

An Arab spoke to him, as a group of people from Basra had sent him when he (peace be upon him) approached Basra, to inquire on their behalf about the reality of his situation with the People of Jamal, so that doubt might be removed from their hearts. He (peace be upon him) explained to him from his affair with them that which made him know that he was upon the truth.
Then he said to him: 'Swear allegiance.' He said: 'I am a messenger of a people, and I will not do anything until I return to them.' So he (peace be upon him) said to him:

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الْجَمَلِ: The People of the Camel (referring to the Battle of Jamal)
key_terms.قِيَامُ الْحُجَّةِ: The rising or emergence of the Proof (Imam)

ai.seo_question: What was Imam Ali's position with the People of Jamal according to this narration?
ai.summary: This passage highlights Imam Ali’s (AS) strategic patience and diplomatic clarity during the Battle of Jamal, where he sent Kolayb al-Jarmi to Basra to dispel doubts about his stance against the Companions. By clarifying his position without immediate allegiance, Ali demonstrated that his conflict was one of principle rather than personal ambition, a key theme in Shia historiography regarding the legitimacy of his rule. The incident underscores the importance of verifying truth through trusted messengers before committing to political or military action.

en.sayed-ali-raza: When Amīr al-mu’minīn approached Baṣrah an Arab met him and spoke to him, as he had been sent to him by a group of people of Baṣrah to enquire from him on their behalf his position vis-à-vis the people of Jamal.

Amīr al-mu’minīn explained to him his position with respect to them, from which he was convinced that Amīr al-mu’minīn was in the right. Then Amīr al-mu’minīn asked him to swear allegiance, but he replied “I am just a message carrier of a people and shall not do anything until I get back to them.” Upon this Amīr al-mu’minīn said to him:
